Class GameResultRepository

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.persistence.GameResultRepository
public final class GameResultRepository extends Object
Persistence gateway for the history of finished matches (advanced feature "Classifica partite su DB").

The history is stored in MySQL with a normalized, three-table model:

  • utenti – one row per distinct player nickname, added the first time the nickname is seen and kept afterwards;
  • partite – one row per completed match, holding the date it was played and the number of players;
  • partecipazioni – the N-to-N relationship between users and matches, carrying the score (prestige points) a player obtained in that specific match.
The same nickname therefore appears in several partecipazioni rows, one for each game it completed, which is what the all-time ranking lists.

This class belongs to the persistence layer and returns only plain data (RankingResult); it never builds network payloads. No connection pool is used: a match ending is a rare event, so every method opens and closes its own short-lived Connection. Methods declare SQLException so the caller can decide how to degrade when the database is unreachable; the server treats such failures as non-fatal and simply skips the ranking instead of interrupting play.

  • Method Details

    • ensureSchema

      public void ensureSchema() throws SQLException
      Creates the utenti, partite and partecipazioni tables if they do not already exist.

      Called once at server startup so the server works against a vanilla MySQL image without any manual schema setup. Tables are created in dependency order because partecipazioni references the other two.

      Throws:
      SQLException - if the database cannot be reached or a statement fails

    • recordResultAndFindRanking

      public RankingResult recordResultAndFindRanking(int numPlayers, List<GameResultRepository.PlayerResult> results) throws SQLException
      Persists the results of one finished match and returns the updated all-time ranking for that player count.

      In a single transaction this inserts one partite row, ensures every player exists in utenti (inserting the nickname only when missing), and links each player to the match in partecipazioni with the score. The ranking is then read back, already including the match just stored.

      Parameters:
      numPlayers - number of players of the match
      results - final result of each participant
      Returns:
      the all-time ranking for numPlayers, with the just-finished match flagged in RankingResult.RankingEntry.isCurrentGame()
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the database cannot be reached or a statement fails
